svg.text: py-spy record -o /h/flames-stock/TP04_structure.svg --rate 50 --nonblocking -- python3 -c from openpyxl import load_workbook wb = load_workbook('input/monthly_operations_template.xlsx', data_only=False) print('Sheets:', wb.sheetnames) for s in wb.sheetnames: ws = wb[s] print(s, ws.max_row, ws.max_column) wb.close()
